expected: With the running backend at http://localhost:8000 healthy (GET /health -> 200), every business-logic endpoint (POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/goals, etc.) should respond normally so live api_checks/playwright_checks can execute.
actual: GET /health returns 200 {"status":"ok","database":"connected"} consistently, but POST /api/auth/login (with valid seeded credentials, e.g. alice.reyes@wealthwise.test) and GET /api/goals (both with no Authorization header and with a garbage Bearer token) all return 500 {"error":{"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"An unexpected error occurred."}}, reproduced consistently across multiple retries over several minutes. A live CORS OPTIONS preflight against the same login path succeeded earlier in this same session (access-control-allow-origin present), so this is not the previously-reported CORS defect recurring - it is a new, distinct failure that appeared partway through this evaluation window.
stack_trace: No direct server stdout/stderr was available to this evaluator (verification.mode=local; .claude/state/process-backend.log exists but its only content is 8 lines from an apparently stale/earlier run - timestamps in it do not align with this session's live requests, and it shows GET /health returning 503, which contradicts the currently-live 200 - so it was not used as evidence). Root cause inferred from code reading only: backend/src/app/dependencies.py:39-46 get_settings() deliberately constructs a fresh, UNCACHED Settings() on every request ("Deliberately not cached" per its own docstring); backend/src/core/config.py's Settings model_validator raises MissingEnvironmentVariableError if DATABASE_URL or JWT_SECRET is absent from the process's current environment. In contrast, backend/src/db/session.py:27-32 get_session_factory() calls Settings() (via db/engine.py:40-43 get_engine()) only ONCE per process and caches the result in a module-global - which is exactly why GET /health (health.py, which reuses that same cached factory) keeps succeeding while every route that depends on require_role()/get_settings() (i.e. every authenticated route in the app) now fails. This pattern is consistent with the live uvicorn --reload worker process having been restarted (e.g. by the reload watcher picking up the CORS/sum_bps source edits) without DATABASE_URL/JWT_SECRET still present in its environment - they were passed as real shell env vars per team instruction, not via backend/.env (which must not exist on disk), so a respawned worker missing them would only surface on the next uncached Settings() call, exactly as observed.
